To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a monoclonal kappa light chain antibody was produced and characterized.
we have produced a monoclonal anti-kappa sheep antibody that can recognize all sheep light chain isotypes.
McM11, a monoclonal anti-kappa antibody, was developed and characterized for the first time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the production of a monocional antibody against a specific light chain of the immunoglobulin molecule, sheep kappa.
the development of monoclonal antibodies to sheep immunoglobulins.
the development of monoclonal antibodies against sheep kappa and lambda light chains and with their use for identification and isolation of lymphocyte populations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the McM11 is a specific monoclonal sheep anti sheep kappa antibody.
the McM11 monoclonal antibody recognizes all sheep kappa light chains.
McM11 is a monoclonal kappa specific antibody.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a monoclonal sheep kappa light chain specific antibody that will be useful in the analysis of sheep lymphocytes.

we have produced two monoclonal antibodies that recognize all sheep light chain proteins and we have shown that they are useful in identifying and quantitating the sheep lymphoid cells in blood and efferent lymph.

we have produced a monoclonal kappa specific antibody that can be used in a two color FACS assay to determine the relative proportions of lambda and kappa light chain expressing cells in the sheep immune system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
McM11 can be used in combination with McM6 to identify all sheep B lymphocytes by flow cytometry and that McM11 can recognize sheep kappa light chains in western blots.
McM11 is a useful reagent for the identification of sheep light chains in a variety of applications.
McM11 is an excellent antibody for use in flow cytometric analysis of the sheep immune system.
